wiki.title: Gary L. Daniels
wiki.extract: Gary L. Daniels (born May 16, 1954) is an American politician serving as a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Hillsborough 43rd district. He previously served as a member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives sporadically from 1990 through 2014, and served as a member of the New Hampshire Senate from 2014 to 2018, and most recently 2020 to 2022.
